manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U} plus {X}, where {X} is Jackal's power minus {1}
easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
description:
Cast Wildwood Scourge by paying {G} plus an additional amount of mana equal to Jackal's power minus {1}.
Jackal triggers, copying the Wildwood Scourge spell and putting a +1/+1 counter on Jackal.
Resolve both Wildwood Scourge spells.
Cast Ego Erasure by paying {2}{U}, targeting yourself.
Put a +1/+1 counter on either Wildwood Scourge.
The other Wildwood Scourge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat step 6 infinitely.
